ldap_server_host.description: LDAP server hostname or IP address (e.g., ldap.example.com or 192.168.1.10)

ldap_server_port.description: LDAP server port (commonly 389 for LDAP, 636 for LDAPS)

ldap_use_tls.description: Enable STARTTLS for the connection (non-SSL, upgrade to TLS after connecting)

ldap_base_dn.description: Base Distinguished Name (DN) for directory searches

bind_auth_type.description: Authentication method for binding: 'config' (static credentials) or 'bind' (prompt user)

bind_dn.description: DN to bind as when using 'config' auth type. Leave empty for anonymous bind.

bind_password.description: Password for the bind DN. Required only when using 'config' auth type and bind_dn is set.

friendly_attrs.description: List of LDAP attributes to display prominently in listings (e.g., table views)

required_attrs.description: Attributes required to be present when adding/modifying entries

search_list_filter.description: LDAP filter used for listing entries in the directory tree

search_read_filter.description: LDAP filter applied when reading a single entry

search_write_filter.description: LDAP filter applied when writing/modifying entries

ldap_verify_peer.description: Verify SSL certificate peer (required for secure LDAPS)

schema_attr_order.description: Order of attributes in the UI form (top to bottom)

schema_attr_display.description: Mapping of LDAP attributes to human-readable labels in the UI

default_server_id.description: Default server ID to load on first access (when multiple servers configured)

default_tree_dn.description: Default DN to show in the directory tree

default_language.description: Default language/locale for the web UI (e.g., en_US, fr_FR)

ui_theme.description: Theme name for the web UI (e.g., 'phpldapadmin', 'phpldapadmin-dark')

debug_enabled.description: Enable detailed debugging output (only for troubleshooting)

additional_servers.description: List of additional LDAP servers (beyond the primary)

name.description: Unique identifier for this server (alphanumeric, underscores only)

host.description: Hostname or IP of the LDAP server

bind_dn.description: Bind DN for this server (if using 'config' auth)

bind_password.description: Password for bind DN (if using 'config' auth)

base_dn.description: Base DN for this server's tree

allow_anonymous_bind.description: Allow users to bind anonymously (if no credentials provided)

session_timeout.description: Session timeout in seconds before re-authentication is required
